parameters.content:
## SEO Entity Gap Engine

### How it works

This workflow runs a weekly, manual, or webhook-triggered SEO entity gap analysis across tracked topics. It builds a topic queue, crawls the site’s own URLs and competitor URLs, uses Claude to extract entities, computes gaps, and asks a Claude gap agent to produce topic-level recommendations. Significant gaps are sent immediately by WhatsApp, and a final digest is sent and returned to the webhook when the run completes.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Schedule Trigger cadence and enable the Webhook URL for registering or running ad hoc topics.
- Set the workflow configuration values in `Set - Config`, including tracked topics URL, URL limits, gap thresholds, and any run limits.
- Add valid Anthropic API credentials or headers for all Claude HTTP Request nodes.
- Configure WhatsApp credentials, recipient IDs, and message templates for both alert and digest nodes.
- Ensure the tracked topics endpoint returns the expected topic, your-site URL, and competitor URL fields used by the queue-building code nodes.

### Customization

Adjust crawl limits, competitor mention thresholds, and significant-gap thresholds in the config node. Claude prompts in the entity extraction and gap-agent API nodes can be customized to change entity taxonomy, scoring, or recommendation style.

## Trigger and normalize input

Starts the workflow from a schedule, webhook, or manual test run, then normalizes the incoming payload into a consistent shape for downstream processing.

## Configure trigger mode

Applies runtime configuration, determines whether the run is ad hoc or scheduled, and branches toward the appropriate topic source.

## Build topic queue

Creates the topic queue either directly from an ad hoc trigger topic or by fetching tracked topics from the configured endpoint.

## Control topic iteration

Pulls the next topic from the queue and decides whether to continue analysis or finish the run with a digest.

## Loop own URLs

Iterates through the current topic’s own-site URL queue and routes either to page crawling or to entity extraction once all own URLs are collected.

## Collect own page text

Fetches each own-site page, parses usable page text, accumulates it, and loops back for the next own URL.

## Extract own entities

Sends accumulated own-site text to Claude and parses the returned entity set for the topic.

## Prepare competitor queue

Builds and controls the competitor URL queue, deciding whether to keep crawling competitors or move on to aggregation.

## Fetch competitor pages

Adds a crawl delay, retrieves the current competitor page HTML, and parses it into clean text for entity extraction.

## Extract competitor entities

Sends competitor page text to Claude, parses the returned entities, accumulates them, and returns to the competitor loop.

## Compute entity gaps

Aggregates entity data across all competitors and compares it with the site’s own entities to calculate raw gap signals.

## Generate gap report

Uses Claude as a gap-analysis agent, parses the agent response, builds a topic report, and determines whether the gap is significant.

## Send gap alert

Sends an immediate WhatsApp alert when a topic has a significant entity gap, then loops back to the next topic.

## Send final digest

Builds the final entity gap digest after all topics are processed, sends it through WhatsApp, and returns it to the webhook caller.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 1200, system: 'You are an SEO entity analyst. You are given the combined content of one website\'s pages on a topic. Extract every distinct named entity relevant to the topic - people, organizations/brands, products, technologies, concepts, methods, or other topically-relevant terms - and rate how prominently each is covered. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {\"entities\": [{\"name\": string, \"type\": \"person\"|\"organization\"|\"product\"|\"concept\"|\"technology\"|\"other\", \"prominence\": \"mentioned_briefly\"|\"discussed\"|\"dedicated_section\"}]}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Topic: ' + $json.currentTopic + '\nPages:\n' + JSON.stringify($json.yourSitePages) } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 1000, system: 'You are an SEO entity analyst. You are given one competitor page's content on a topic. Extract every distinct named entity relevant to the topic - people, organizations/brands, products, technologies, concepts, methods, or other topically-relevant terms - and rate how prominently each is covered. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {"entities": [{"name": string, "type": "person"|"organization"|"product"|"concept"|"technology"|"other", "prominence": "mentioned_briefly"|"discussed"|"dedicated_section"}]}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Competitor: ' + $json.currentCompetitorName + '
Topic: ' + $json.currentTopic + '
Page title: ' + $json.currentCompetitorPageTitle + '
Page text: ' + $json.currentCompetitorPageText } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 1400, system: 'You are an SEO content strategist specializing in entity and topical coverage. Given the entities a page already covers, the entities competitors cover on the same topic (with how many competitors mention each), the raw list of missing entities, and the list of entities covered only weakly compared to competitor consensus, prioritize the gaps by strategic importance, group them into a few thematic clusters, and recommend concrete content changes to close each. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {"topGaps": [{"entity": string, "type": string, "competitorCoverage": number, "whyItMatters": string, "recommendation": string}], "thematicClusters": [{"clusterName": string, "entities": [string]}], "overallSummary": string}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Topic: ' + $json.currentTopic + '
Competitors analyzed: ' + $json.competitorsAnalyzedCount + '
Your entities: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.yourEntities || []).map(e => ({ name: e.name, type: e.type, prominence: e.prominence }))) + '
Missing entities (in competitors, not in yours): ' + JSON.stringify($json.missingEntities.slice(0, 30)) + '
Weakly covered entities: ' + JSON.stringify($json.weaklyCoveredEntities.slice(0, 20)) } ] }) }}
